reason: The cheap way in is a filter subscription from a brand I've never heard of, and I've been burned too many times by 'cancel any time'. Paying $63 for the bottle alone with shipping, just to dodge the plan, is too much when the gym tap water is fine for me.
objection: Another subscription I'll forget to cancel, and if this new brand goes quiet I'm stuck with a bottle that needs their filters.
would_change_my_mind: Selling filters as plain one-off buys at a fair price, with the bottle at $39.99 and no plan required.
